prompts.name: friends-on-bench-landscape
prompts.prompt:
Use case photorealistic-natural. New documentary school-life image illustrating Mucheke High School, Masvingo Zimbabwe. The user's latest screenshots are references for relaxed candid composition and friendship ONLY, not green uniforms, other school branding, primary-age children, or architecture. Subjects fictional Black Zimbabwean secondary-school teenagers aged 15-18 with individually distinct faces. ALL wear FORMAL uniform: girls solid purple knee-length sleeveless school pinafores over white short-sleeved collared blouses; boys plain purple tailored trousers and white short-sleeved collared shirts; all diagonal purple/light cyan/magenta striped ties, black school shoes; girls white ankle socks. Never mix in tracksuits, athletic panels, zippers or trainers. Small unobtrusive approximate badge without invented lettering. Setting modest low single-storey brick/plaster classroom blocks with corrugated roofs, verandas, clipped courtyard hedges, mature trees and imperfect concrete paving guided by earlier real Mucheke photos. High-detail ordinary photography, skin pores and tiny imperfections, individual hair strands, woven cotton, slightly wrinkled garments, scuffed shoes, natural unretouched faces, restrained colour, no waxy skin, no glamour retouching, no stock-photo perfect smiles, no watermark, no graphic borders or page UI. One image per call.
Scene: landscape 3:2, three teenage girl friends sitting comfortably on a simple wooden courtyard bench in front of a leafy hedge, chatting and laughing with each other during break. One holds a closed exercise book, one turns toward her friend mid-sentence, one laughs softly; varied candid expressions, nobody posing in identical ways. Eye-level medium-wide view including legs and shoes; school veranda visible behind hedge. Dappled late-morning daylight, genuine documentary texture. Follow the bench friendship scene in user's screenshot, adapted to Mucheke formal uniform.
